thread:
carla: quick sync 1 - spotted several generate examples using "max_new_tokens" and response samples with "choices[0].text". runtime now expects "max_tokens" and returns outputs[].content. also a handful of curl snippets still show header "X-Request-Id" instead of our normalized "x-rw-request-id".

owen: thanks for flagging. can you drop exact file paths? i'll grep the repo and open a single PR that covers the openapi examples + generate page.

carla: i found them under docs/api/generate.md, examples/generate.json, and openapi/components/examples/generate-response.json. also quickstart/python snippet uses old import `from redwood import Client`. new package is `redwood_sdk.RedwoodClient`.

priya: i'll take node/js snippets (streaming and non-streaming). note: streaming events changed from `type: 'delta'` with `delta.text` to `type: 'message'` with `message.parts` (partial parts array). i'll add a small helper showing join.

ravi: i'll patch openapi.yaml to replace `choices` examples with `outputs` and add an explicit operationId on /generate so codegen doesn't pick up old ids. also adding `x-example-id` to keep anchors stable in the docs renderer.

zhen: heads-up: the docs preview renderer needs explicit HTML id attributes on some headings or anchors will shift when we change text. i can add the ids while editing the markdown.

carla: nice. i opened a tracking ticket and a docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/921 (covers generate md, openapi examples, quickstart snippets, and troubleshooting). tagged sdk-owners.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/921 1 - carla, priya, ravi requested for review :robot:

owen: CI on the PR failed with docs-validate complaining that examples/generate.json used "choices". i'll update the tests to run `npm run docs-validate -- examples/generate.json` in the PR so we catch regressions.

priya: pushed node changes. streaming example now checks `if (event.type === 'message')` and merges `event.message.parts`. non-streaming example uses `max_tokens`. also updated curl to `-H "x-rw-request-id: some-id"`.

ravi: openapi patch pushed: swapped examples, set operationId: `generateText`, and added `x-example-id`s. note: i left a small comment around schema versioning in case older SDKs still expect choices; maybe we should add a short migration guide.

carla: yes please add a Migration section in the generate page: short bullet list: - rename `max_new_tokens` -> `max_tokens`, - parse responses from `outputs[].content` (example snippet for JS/Python/Go), - header rename. keep language soft: "If you previously used ..."

zhen: added explicit html id on the "Request / Response" h3 so anchors in the preview stay stable. pushed that tiny change.

product-docs: suggested we include a brief Go example given customers use it in platform teams. can someone add a 2-line Go snippet showing how to read outputs[].content?

priya: added Go and Ruby snippets to the PR. Go example uses our new `redwood-go` client and shows `resp.Outputs[0].Content`. ruby shows `resp.outputs.first.content`. kept them minimal.

owen: re-ran docs-validate locally, all examples pass. requesting reviews from api-team and sdk-owners.

docs-bot: requested reviews from api-team, sdk-owners, product-docs :robot:

carla: product docs wording updated in PR based on feedback. added a short migration callout under Breaking Changes and linked to release-notes/docs.

release-bot: please add to release notes: "API examples: parameter rename max_new_tokens -> max_tokens; response shape: choices -> outputs[].content; header normalization: X-Request-Id -> x-rw-request-id; SDK updates: Python package -> redwood_sdk.RedwoodClient; Node streaming event shape changed to message/parts." :rocket:

carla: done, added entry in docs/release-notes/2026-03-22.md and cc'd release lead.

preview-bot: docs-preview deploy queued for pr-921 1 - preview will be posted when ready :robot:

priya: preview looks good when i clicked through examples. codeblocks render with correct language tags. streaming helper demonstrates collecting parts: `const text = message.parts.join('')`.

owen: after api review i got one suggestion to add an explicit note about backwards compatibility for any SDKs pinned to older generated clients; i added a short note and a link to the OpenAPI commit.

carla: reviews complete, merging after green CI. thanks everyone for quick turnaround. i'll follow up to ensure the older SDKs get a migration blurb in the Changelog.

product-docs: nice work :thumbsup:

release-bot: docs-preview deploy started for pr-921 1 - will post URL on completion :rocket:
